name: Camera Intrinsics Simplification — FOV from Intrinsics, Field of View Calculation, Simplified Camera Intrinsics, Square Pixel Camera Model, get_fov): Computes the horizontal and vertical field of view (FOV) angles from intrinsic camera matrices.
aliases: Vertical FOV to Horizontal FOV Conversion
summary: This function converts vertical to horizontal field of view using a simplified square pixel model, avoiding full matrix decomposition for efficient ray generation in volume rendering.
